ags-3598-44.summary: January 1643: Tortona has just been retaken, the war with France weighs on the Milanese, and Madrid is pressing the Italian princes bound to Spain to send troops. The ambassador at Genoa, Juan de Eraso, has forwarded the King’s letter to Grand Duke Ferdinand II de’ Medici. The answer comes back: the Grand Duke refers the matter to his resident in Madrid. Eraso tells the King, in cipher, that this is a way of playing for time.

system: the 1643 cipher of the Genoa embassy (a different table from that of 1638): syllabic series of five numbers (27 fa, 32 ta, 37 as, 42 na, 47 ja, 52 al, 57 da, 62 an), disguised bigrams (ax = la, at = sa, ha = ma, am = ya), trigrams (sal = ra, gan = ca, tes =…
